description: Employee Details module — list, search, filter, sort, pagination, edit drawer
businessRules: Current tab shows only active employees; Past tab shows only archived/deallocated — never mix
Search, filter, sort, and pagination state are INDEPENDENT per tab; tab switch must not carry state
Last Updated must come from API only — any frontend computation is a defect
All grid values must exactly match the corresponding API response
After Edit Drawer save, grid must reflect changes immediately without page reload
Cancel on Edit Drawer must discard all changes; grid shows original pre-edit values
Reset on Basic Filters clears all criteria and restores unfiltered list for current tab only
Employee count in grid rows, result-count badge, and API total must always match
Advanced Filters: Save applies all; Cancel reverts to last-applied state
Any destructive or irreversible action (Delete Employee, Deallocate Project) must present a confirmation dialog before executing; dismissing/cancelling the dialog must make no change.
Archived/deallocated employee records must appear only under the Past-employees tab and never resurface in the active list, active dropdowns, or active search results.
Submitting 'Add project allocation', 'Add note', or 'Add project - tentative projects' twice in quick succession (double-click Save/Submit) must not create duplicate records.

Each role's permitted and forbidden actions on the Reporting-Manager team view (view allocation summaries, add/edit allocation, add/edit notes, edit/delete/archive employee) must be enforced at both UI level (element hidden/disabled) and API level (403 on unauthorized write).
Impersonating an employee via 'Login as Employee' must never grant more access than that employee's own role/data scope permits, at both UI and API level (manual requirement, 2026-08-19).

Saving the 'Action - edit employee' drawer must cause the grid AND every open hover/side-drawer allocation view (hover popup, expanded project-details sheet) to reflect the updated values immediately, without a page reload.

Allocation %, Logged Hours %, and Billability-split values shown in the hover popup, the expanded project-details sheet, and any underlying API response for the same employee/project must always match exactly.

PIP-related status fields (if implemented as a discrete Status value, e.g. Active/Overdue/Completed/Cancelled) must only reflect valid state transitions consistent with the PIP date range and any explicit Status field — the indicator must never show a stale prior state (e.g. 'Active' after PIP End Date has passed, if Overdue is later implemented as a distinct state).
PIP fields (Status, Reason, Start Date, End Date) displayed in the Employee List indicator/tooltip must exactly match the corresponding API/data-source values for that employee.
Each role's permitted and forbidden access to the PIP indicator/tooltip must be enforced at both UI level (element hidden) and API level (403/omitted data) for unauthorized roles.
Applying an existing Employee List filter (Basic or Advanced) must produce filtered results/counts unaffected by the addition of the PIP indicator/column.
Sorting by any column (including Name) must remain stable and produce the same order as before the PIP indicator was added; rows with identical PIP status must maintain stable secondary ordering.

Employee Origin must be logically consistent with Cohort for the same employee: any Cohort value starting with 'Trainee Hire' implies Employee Origin = 'Campus Hire'; any Cohort value starting with 'Experienced Hire' implies Employee Origin = 'Lateral Hire' (manual requirement, 2026-08-20, source: Zoho Analytics 'Employee Details - SimERP - Shared with Abhishek - Raw Table').

Cohort and Employee Origin filter option lists and per-row column values must exactly match the Zoho Analytics source-table values — no client-side relabeling, truncation, or reformatting (manual requirement, 2026-08-20).

Applying an Allocation filter must update both the displayed rows and the result count ('Showing x - y of N results'); clearing it must restore the full list; a zero-match filter must show a readable empty state, and an active filter must always be visible as a chip.
Allocation-stage data (LR/Upcoming flags, stats count, Allocation filter) must be enforced per role at UI (hidden/Access Denied) and API (403) level; Employee persona sees none.
Hovering the Availability 'i' icon and LR badges must show the same tooltip content on every row with that data, including the last row and rows on page 2.

Each role's permitted and forbidden actions for Working Location (employee scope + window visibility per Section 4) must be enforced at both UI level (tab/column hidden) and API level (403), including PM/CSM's feature-specific scoping layered on top of their module-level 'Full (View)' Employees access.

Any Working Location value (7-day strip, window %s, 'Data as of' date) rendered across the Employee Profile tab, Employee List column, Project Details column, or Overview dashboard must match the corresponding backend API value for the same employee/department/window.
The 'Employees With No Data' and 'Departments Below Threshold' KPI counts on the dashboard must match the API's computed counts and stay consistent with the department rollup rows shown below them.
Sorting the Employee List by the new Working Location column must produce a stable order and toggle direction on re-click, matching the existing header sort convention.
Existing Employee List filters must continue to update displayed rows/counts correctly after the Working Location column is added, independent of the column's visibility toggle state.
edgeCases: Null Reporting Manager — cell renders gracefully, no JS crash
Null Skills — Skills cell renders without +N chip
Null Department / Null Projects — graceful fallback display
Single search result — grid shows '1 of 1', pagination controls disabled
Zero results — empty-state message shown, count badge = 0
Large dataset (500+ records) — all perf targets met, pagination accurate
API 500 error — user-friendly error displayed, no JS crash
XSS in search input — escaped rendering, no script execution
Special characters in search (hyphens, apostrophes, accents, Unicode) — correct matching
Pagination boundary — add/archive employee while on last page, no duplicates or missing records
Advanced filter: Available Since end < start — validation error shown
Advanced filter: Availability % = 101 or Experience = -1 — rejected
Tab switch with active search — search does NOT persist to other tab
Double-click Save in Edit Drawer — no duplicate update, no record corruption
Feature flag disabled mid-session — graceful handling, no crash
Skills detail view header count (46) exceeds the number of visible badges captured (33) — verify this is a confirmed pagination/'show more' mechanism and not a truncation/missing-badge bug.
Tentative projects list must show the exact empty-state copy "No tentative projects selected. Use the dropdown above to add projects." before any project is added.
Column setting dropdown item labels are unrecoverable from this export — verify the dropdown opens without crashing even though exact toggle labels are unconfirmed.

A hidden Table Row variant is present on the Column setting, Add-project, Skills, and Past-employees screens — verify the corresponding empty/error/loading row state renders correctly rather than a raw broken/hidden row leaking into the UI.

Deallocation flow is stacked three dialog layers deep (base table -> project drawer -> log form dialog -> confirmation modal) — verify the confirmation modal is reachable and dismissible without breaking or closing the underlying drawer stack.
Archived/Past-employee side drawer must remain read-only (no edit affordance beyond the close icon) despite being structurally near-identical to the active-employee drawer.
Hover-revealed row action menu and allocation summary must remain consistent for the last visible row, a newly added row, and rows reached after pagination.
Add note and Edit note reuse the same form component — verify Edit mode arrives pre-filled with existing values and that Cancel does not silently persist partial edits.

Billability breakdown is inconsistent between two surfaces for what should be the same allocation record: the hover popup shows a 2-bucket split (Non-billable/Billable), while the expanded 'View project details' sheet shows a 3-bucket split adding 'Not allotted' — verify both surfaces reconcile to the same underlying data rather than diverging.
PIP starts today
PIP ends today
PIP has expired but status remains Active
Missing PIP reason
Long PIP reason
Multiple PIP records for one employee
Invalid date range (Start Date > End Date)
Null or missing PIP dates
Employee appears correctly in search/sorting/pagination results
Employee has both Notice Period AND PIP indicators simultaneously

PIP Status transitions through every plausible boundary (Upcoming → Active → Expired/Overdue → Completed/Cancelled) — verify the indicator only reflects a genuinely active, in-range PIP and never a stale prior state.
PIP fields shown in the indicator/tooltip vs. the same data returned directly from the API/data source for that employee — verify they match exactly.
Use a restricted-role/unauthorized session to attempt viewing the PIP indicator/tooltip via both the UI and a direct API call — verify it's hidden/blocked in both.
Apply an existing Basic/Advanced filter combination and verify filtered results/counts are unaffected by the new PIP indicator/column.
Sort the grid by Name (and other sortable columns) with multiple employees sharing the same PIP status — verify sort order/stability is unaffected by the new indicator.

Employee Profile exposes a 'Login as Employee' impersonation entry point from both active and past employee views (manual requirement, 2026-08-19) — not yet confirmed against live DOM; while impersonating, the impersonated employee's own permission/data scope must apply, never the admin's.
Employee Profile includes a LinkedIn profile URL field, addable/editable (manual requirement, 2026-08-19) — not yet confirmed against live DOM.

Employee Profile includes a Visa Information section supporting Add/Edit/Delete of visa records, with delete gated by a confirmation dialog (manual requirement, 2026-08-19) — not yet confirmed against live DOM.

Employee Profile's 'PR Reviewer' section shows a Project/Frequency table (confirmed via figma-employee-module-design-brief.md node 26709:253255, values include Occasionally/Very Rarely/Not at all/Frequently) — reachable from the employee profile per manual requirement 2026-08-19.

GROUNDED (2026-08-18 DOM snapshot): 'Employee Origin' and 'Cohort' already exist live as Advanced Filter panel accordion sections AND as Table-options grid columns (default hidden) on the Employee screen — the Employee-screen-filter half of the 2026-08-20 manual request is already shipped, not a gap.

NOT yet confirmed against a live DOM snapshot: whether Cohort/Employee Origin are surfaced in the Employee Profile view's Personal Information section (manual requirement, 2026-08-20) — the Employee Profile view itself remains generically/unconfirmed since 2026-08-19; treat a genuinely-absent field there as a real product gap, not an automation defect.
Cohort values follow the pattern '<Trainee|Experienced> Hire - <year>' — verify the accordion's live option list contains only well-formed values of this shape with no unexpected relabeling.

A logically contradictory Cohort + Employee Origin filter combination (e.g. a 'Trainee Hire' cohort paired with 'Lateral Hire' origin) must yield zero results via the normal empty-state, never a UI error.

GROUNDED (2026-08-20, playwright codegen): the Employee-screen grid's 'Filter by <Column>' column-header quick-filter (the same shared dialog already used for Department/RM/Projects) also works for Cohort/Employee Origin once that column is toggled visible via Table options — a live-recorded click resolved as `getByRole('button', {name:'Filter by Cohort'})` then `getByText('<value>', {exact:true})`, an easier and confirmed-working alternative to the Advanced Filter panel's own unconfirmed Cohort combobox.

GROUNDED (2026-08-20, playwright codegen): the Table-options Column-Visibility switches for Cohort/Employee Origin ARE directly clickable via an unscoped `page.getByRole('switch', {name: 'Cohort'|'Employee Origin'})` — a page-object bug (not a product gap) had these scoped only to a dialog matched via `hasText: 'Column Visibility'`, which didn't reliably resolve for every column; fixed 2026-08-20 by adding a page-level `.or()` fallback.

OPEN FOLLOW-UP (2026-08-20, live probe): selecting Cohort='Experienced Hire - 2024' via the 'Filter by Cohort' quick-filter dialog reproducibly leaves the grid showing an unrelated/unfiltered row (Cohort cell reads '—') even though the identical selectColumnQuickFilter() mechanism works cleanly for 'Trainee Hire - 2023' (TC-EMPDET-379/380 pass). Root cause unconfirmed — suspect the option list is virtualized and 'Experienced Hire - 2024' wasn't actually scrolled into view/clicked despite the locator reporting visible. Needs a dedicated live-probe pass scrolling the dialog's option list before concluding either a product or automation defect.

OPEN FOLLOW-UP (2026-08-20, live probe): `getDataRows()` (`getByRole('row').filter({hasNot: getByRole('columnheader')})`) was observed, in at least one render state, to include the grid's own header row as its first result — the header's `<th>` cells didn't register role=columnheader against this app's table markup that time, so the filter failed to exclude it, and the header row's cells (which also don't register role=cell) can surface confusingly as '—' reads at unrelated column indices depending on timing/filter state. This is a shared-method risk affecting any test that iterates `getDataRows()` from index 0 doing exact per-cell assertions (most existing tests only ever call `.first()` for a single action and don't hit it) — worth a dedicated grounding pass on `getDataRows()`/`getColumnIndexByLabel()` before trusting exhaustive row-by-row assertions elsewhere in this module.

GROUNDED (2026-08-20 live probe): unlike every other Advanced Filter accordion section (Departments, Designation, Employee Origin, etc.), which render their expanded content as a flat `role="checkbox"` list, the 'Cohort' section's expanded content is a single `role="combobox"` button (placeholder 'Select...', `aria-haspopup="dialog"`) — presumably a searchable single-select given Cohort's high cardinality (many Trainee/Experienced × year combinations). A direct-probe click on that combobox did not reliably open its popup in a scripted session (`data-state` stayed `closed`) — the exact open/select interaction (click target, possible portal/z-index issue, or a required pointerdown vs. click event) remains unconfirmed and needs a real interactive grounding pass before Cohort-value-selection tests (TC-EMPDET-379/380/384 and similar) can move past their current 'not found — selector unconfirmed' skip state. Employee Origin, being only 2 values, is unaffected and already fully automatable via the checkbox path.
Allocation start date exactly 2 calendar months before today (e.g. today 2026-09-28, start 2026-07-28) — must NOT be flagged Long-Running ('more than 2 months'); live dev agrees.
Allocation start date 2 calendar months + 1 day before today — must be flagged Long-Running.
Allocation 60 or 61 days old but less than 2 calendar months — shows whether the rule is days-based or month-based (live: not flagged, so month-based).
Month-end arithmetic: today = 31 Mar / 30 Apr / 29 Feb — 'two months ago' resolves to a date that does not exist (31 Jan, 29/30/31 Dec); confirm deterministic behaviour.
Long-running allocation whose end date is in the past (ended) — must not be flagged Long-Running nor counted on the card.
Long-running allocation whose end date is today — still running today; confirm it stays flagged and also appears under Upcoming Deallocation.
Allocation with a percentage/type change via Update Allocation ticket (new SCHEDULED timeline segment) — Long-Running age must count from the original start date (continuity preserved).
Allocation that was deallocated and re-allocated to the same project with a gap — 'continuously' rule: age must reset at the re-allocation start date.
Back-to-back re-allocation with no gap (end D, new start D+1) — decide whether this is continuous (should probably stay Long-Running).

Employee with multiple allocations on different projects, only some older than 2 months — only those allocations carry the LR label; the employee matches the Long Running filter once (no duplicate rows).
Employee with two allocations on the same project (e.g. FIXED + DYNAMIC) — each evaluated separately; card count counts allocations, not employees.
Start date = today — not Upcoming (already active), counts as Recent (started within 30 days).
Start date exactly 30 days ago — boundary of Recent window (inclusive?); 31 days ago — must not be Recent unless end date is within window.
End date exactly today+30 / today+31 — Upcoming Deallocation boundary.
Combining the Allocation filter with other filters (Department, Projects, Leave & Status) and with search — AND semantics, chip shown per filter.
Selecting multiple Allocation options at once (checkbox group) — union (OR) semantics expected; confirm.
Allocation filter that matches zero records — readable empty state (e.g. 'No projects found' / 'No data available'), never a bare dash.
Timezone: user in a non-IST timezone near midnight — flag computed server-side with date-only values must not flip by a day in the UI.
A window (15/30/90-day) with partial logged data shows the % anyway plus an 'N of X days logged' note (e.g., '42 of 90 days logged').
A window with zero logged days shows 'no data', never 0%.
Employee with no source-table row at all (brand-new joiner) is omitted entirely from every Working Location placement — not shown with a placeholder row.
Blank ZUID row (contractor, departed employee) is filtered out before reaching SimERP and never surfaced anywhere.
'Last 15/30/90 Days' windows are relative to As Of Date, not a fixed calendar range — verify correct date-window computation as As Of Date advances day to day.
100%/0% WFO/WFH split (prototype's 'Neha Kapoor' example) renders correctly without divide-by-zero or layout break.

Overall card/row is entirely absent (not greyed/locked) for non-entitled viewers on the Employee Profile tab, while the prototype's PM hover popup instead shows a locked 'Overall 🔒' row — verify the actual built behaviour resolves this FRD/prototype discrepancy consistently across all 4 placements.
Dashboard 'Departments Below Threshold' badge/count uses a configurable WFO% threshold (prototype hardcodes 50%) — verify behaviour exactly at the threshold boundary.
Daily refresh lag: data refreshes once at 4:00 AM IST — verify 'Data as of' does not change intraday, and a job run before 4 AM IST still shows the prior day's data.
PM/CSM viewing an employee profile for someone not on any of their current or past projects — Working Location tab/section must not render for that employee at all.

Delivery Manager scope edge: a PM who reports to a Delivery Manager but also independently manages projects — verify the DM's view includes that PM's own logged data plus the PM's reports, with no double-counting or gaps.
Admin uses 'Login As' to impersonate a PM/CSM — verify the Overall card/row disappears during impersonation even though Admin normally has global Overall access.
Blank Day value in the 7-day strip renders as a neutral greyed placeholder visually distinct from both WFO and WFH colours.

Pagination counter wrong after search/filter combination

Edit button visibility — missing for some rows
